limits: Whole controlled calls cover 964/971; four NEG paths and three first-plane busy-loop instructions have 81920 independent production segment calls. Do not claim whole-call entry coverage for them.
Every real-child and dispatch owner retains its exact missing PC list. C2FD8C real-child conditions leave seventeen additional parent instructions cold; controlled child contracts cover them.
Whole real-child fixtures execute original child bytes with event service held. Dispatch separately uses actual production generated-child continuations. No production glue calls opcode handlers.

Line input fixtures use bounded original screen geometry, and glyph fixtures use positive original font row counts. The general source branches and DBRA behavior are retained without added production guards.

Sandbox plane dispatch uses the original suppressed-write reference and commits its logged original packets at return, matching the runtime policy. Physical hardware parity is independently proven by both complete-call oracles.
Source guards prove admission/counting only; C2FD8C generated source continuation can stop at cold C2FE02 without starting a native step. This is not a completed source call proof.

Original busy-read comparison opt-ins are preserved. Retained failed full gates differed in one C45927 busy-counter byte before removing newly added opt-ins. No generic checker or shared runtime changed.

Thirty-seven remaining renderer entries, selected-segment dynamic children, older partial adapters, C2C392, C1612C graphics-wait integration and full original cold/indirect/callback reconciliation still prevent function completion.
ALL424/34144, Copper fade and Kickstart services remain deferred.
